newsitem.title: USA: National Semiconductor sees Q1 order gains.
newsitem.headline: National Semiconductor sees Q1 order gains.

text.p: National Semiconductor Corp, one of the largest U.S. makers of computer chips, said on Thursday that orders improved in the first quarter ended August 25, but it stopped short proclaiming an end to the recent industrywide slump.
"Bookings showed improvement throughout the quarter, but we will maintain guarded optimism for a while longer before declaring a trend," Brian Halla, chief executive, said in a statement.
The company reported a first-quarter net loss of $207.6 million, or $1.51 a share, after taking $285.6 million of charges to spin off a unit.
